frequency_policy.access_population: all valid hashed accesses at positions that miss the exact bank in the current accumulated optimizer batch
frequency_policy.count: cumulative packed-row hit count through the current step
frequency_policy.weight: c_r^-q divided by the RMS of c^-q over rows active in that step
frequency_policy.support: active packed rows only; inactive rows and their weights are not advanced
frequency_policy.norm_matching: at every step rescale the complete active-row delta to the observed table-delta L2 norm of the paired high_lr_reference arm at the same seed and step

thresholds.installation_derivation: A routing contrast smaller than 0.15 cannot answer the downstream estimand. With 1024 paired binary contexts, sqrt(2 ln(2/0.05)/1024)=0.084881; 0.15+0.084881=0.234881 protects it at the evaluation-row level.
thresholds.typical_route: A route is present in a seed only when installation reaches 0.234881 and both whole-table necessity and sufficiency exceed 0.15. Typical means the two-sided 95% Wilson lower bound on five-seed prevalence exceeds 0.5; with n=5 this requires 5/5.
thresholds.quality_claim: A constructive policy has a positive paired five-seed lower 95% Student-t endpoint for clean-NLL cost reduction versus high_lr_reference. No zero-cost or noninferiority claim is made from failure to reject zero.
thresholds.mechanism_claim: Frequency allocation changes routing at fixed nominal rate or fixed table-update norm only if the paired lower 95% endpoint for its table-routing contrast exceeds +0.15 (or the upper endpoint is below -0.15 for the opposite direction).

verification.source: full deterministic replay of all 60 cells, causal interventions, evaluation rows, optimizer logs, and decisions
verification.integrity: canonical hashes plus sealed output manifests

budget.scale_justification: Five independent seeds are the minimum at which a unanimous route has a two-sided Wilson lower bound above one half. Six paired policies isolate ordinary AdamW, the known high-rate route, active-row support, frequency allocation at equal nominal rate, and frequency allocation at equal stepwise update norm at both established model sizes.
